# Synthetic provider-observation fixture

`synthetic-single-product-90-days.json` is generated by `generate-fixture.ts`, which runs Pricing's executable provider-observation mapper. Its behavioral source is the read-only `todd-skelton/tcgplayer-automation-app` checkout at `bdeffa0190be035084abccb464716aaaa2541a59`.

This fixture is unmistakably synthetic. It is not a live provider response, external-authority receipt, or parity claim. Sale counts retain provider-returned tuple-multiplicity semantics within one capture and are never presented as stable real-order identity across captures. Listing rows retain only the capture-local, non-identifying ordinal required to preserve the seller-condition-delivered-amount joint. Synthetic seller handles exist only in generator memory; the committed JSON contains no seller/listing identity, cookie, authorization value, response body, or exception text.

`provider-observation-fixture-equivalence.test.ts` regenerates the JSON, verifies exact equivalence, and proves that a hand edit is rejected. The same test performs the privacy marker scan.
